in_marathi.name: Arjani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arjani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arjani is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'arjana', meaning 'exalted' or 'respected'. This name has rich historical significance in Hindu mythology as the name of several revered figures, including Arjuna, the great warrior of the Mahabharata epic.
